$comment: Deliberate, PERMANENT absences of @stable, read by scripts/reconcile-stable-orphans.ts (#1746).
An entry silences exactly one test's removal, matched on (spec, title) — titles do not drift, line numbers do.

It is verified in BOTH directions (#1084's lesson): if the test carries @stable again, gains a lane tag that already keeps it out of the daily (#1010), is renamed, or turns out never to have carried @stable at all, the declaration is REPORTED as expired instead of being honoured silently — otherwise this check grows the exact silent-expiry problem it exists to close.

A TEMPORARY absence does not belong here. That is what an open issue naming the spec file is for: the reconciler treats any open tracker that names the file as an owner, so a quarantine with a live issue is already accounted for and needs no declaration.

exemptions.title: the Groq component configures the API key and executes the flow
exemptions.reason: The Groq components are not bundled in the tested image — component availability is a packaging decision per image, and the standing answer lives in docs/component-distribution-policy.md rather than in a tracker. Restoring @stable would put a test that cannot pass into the daily.

exemptions.title: the MistralAI component configures the API key and executes the flow
exemptions.reason: The MistralAI components are not bundled in the tested image — the same packaging decision as Groq, recorded in docs/component-distribution-policy.md.

exemptions.title: Loop component — Research Translation Loop template: full wiring and iterates over 2 ArXiv papers
exemptions.reason: The template this test loads is never registered by the tested image: ArXivComponent ships as the separate lfx-arxiv distribution (upstream src/bundles/arxiv/, its own pyproject.toml and extension.json) and the image does not install it, so filter_starter_projects_by_available_components drops the starter project at startup — "Skipping starter project 'Research Translation Loop'; unavailable components: ArXivComponent". Measured on 1.13.0.dev26: zero occurrences of "arxiv" anywhere in GET /api/v1/all (3.2 MB), the template absent from the 26 registered starter projects although its JSON is one of the 27 on disk, and no lfx/components/arxiv directory at all — under the bundle layout there is no shim to raise ModuleNotFoundError, which is why this surfaced through template registration rather than through the catalog. Same packaging decision as Groq/Mistral, recorded in docs/component-distribution-policy.md. The test keeps test.fixme rather than a gate: a gate exists to turn a deep misleading timeout into an attributed skip, and an inert declaration already prevents any run — while templates-registration.spec.ts (@stable) fails the moment the template comes back, naming the declaration to delete, which is a louder lift signal than a self-healing gate.
